text:
marta: Console alert: spike in invoke_rejects for tool=\"payment_processor\" on route=\"new-routing-experiment\". Main errors: \"invalid_output_shape\" (expected object with fields payment_id, status) and \"parse_error\". Anyone on this path?

devon: Can you paste an example?

marta: Example from ES:
```json
{"req":"r-201","tool":"payment_processor","error":"invalid_output_shape","expected":{"type":"object","fields":["payment_id","status"]},"actual":"[\"payment_id\",\"status\"]"}
```

casey: That looks like the lighter-weight model variant returning arrays for the success branch. We promoted that tag to experiment yesterday. It should've been gated.

irene: Do validation rejects bubble into customer SLAs or billing? We just got a billing-bot alert for anomalous errors.

billing-bot: Alert: unusual error rate for acct=pay-co derived from invokes.rejects

casey: We currently emit invoke.rejects as an error stream. Telemetry needs richer tags: add validation_reason, validation_action (coerced/blocked), route_origin. Also mark coercion=true if adapter transforms.

marta: Short-term plan: adapter will coerce array -> object when len==2, set trace flag coercion=true, and treat as soft-reject so downstream billing/alerts ignore. Will roll to new-routing-experiment only.

devon: That will reduce noise but risks hiding regressions. Also add a pre-rollout schema test in the model push CI (run canonical prompts and assert shape). I can add it.

casey: Console UX request: show per-route reject reason histogram + one-click sample payload view + quick rollback button linking last stable model tag. Support needs to filter by coercion flag.

ops-bot: deploy started: adapter-coerce-fix -> new-routing-experiment (initiated by marta)

irene: I'll mute billing alerts for validation-rejects for 1 hour. Add a console note: \"coercion=true indicates runtime fix applied\".

marta: Pushed PR: github.com/redwood/adapter/pull/432. CI green, canary deploy in progress.

devon: I'll also add a 10% sample of full payloads for rejects (redact PII) and a histogram metric reject_rate_by_route.

casey: Action items: 1) marta deploy adapter patch, 2) devon add telemetry tags + sampling, 3) irene suppress billing alerts, 4) casey add pre-rollout schema check.

marta: Adapter canary up, seeing reduced pages. Will monitor for 30m and revert model tag if we see more anomalies.

irene: Console filters updated to include validation_action and coercion flag. Added \"how to fix\" doc link.

marta: Filing short RCA if we need rollback. Thanks team.
